authority: User-authorized image placement, interactive Table/Section creation and Table text row growth, 2026-11-06. Additive interaction contract; existing Table/1 and Section/1 wire semantics remain unchanged.

owners.placement_gesture_and_preview: CanvasEditingRuntime, existing normalized pointer path and shared Skia creation preview
owners.table_text_fit: Runtime text operation owner, shared text layout, existing atomic intent/History/publication

contract.image: Ordinary SDK byte import centers the image's geometric center on the mounted viewport center in world coordinates. Preserve existing aspect/size rules. Explicit developer-profile prepared image transforms and replacement remain unchanged.
contract.creation_presets: Append Table=6 and Section=7 to the existing creation preset vocabulary. JS selectShape accepts table/section; shared Session and caller-side Windows wrapper adapt the same bounded command. Unknown values still reject. No DLL exports or semantic enum changes.
contract.table_gesture: Click creates 2x2 at the pointer. Drag changes counts in 120x48 world-unit cells, with at least 2 rows and 2 columns. Counts ceil the extents; drag direction keeps the initial corner fixed. Bound columns to 64 and rows to min(64,floor(1024/columns)); preview and commit use identical counts. Omitted programmatic Table counts default to 2x2; explicit API sizes retain the existing 1..64 range.
contract.section_gesture: Tool selection does not create an object. Click creates the existing default 320x240 Section at the pointer; drag creates a normalized custom boundary with minimum 24x24 world units. Reuse existing hierarchy and selection semantics; do not implicitly wrap existing objects.
contract.lifecycle: Transient drag does not mutate canonical state or publish operations. Capture full pointer key, semantic/camera/metrics/selection stamps and scope. Cancel, source retirement, additional touch contacts or stale basis discard the preview. Success returns to point selection; Table opens its first cell.
contract.row_growth: Confirmed cell text edits grow the edited row only when its measured content plus 6-unit padding on each side exceeds current height. Measure all cells of that row using shared layout. Do not shrink rows automatically. Honor maximum 16384 height; unavailable layout or exceeding bounds rejects before mutation.
contract.atomicity: Table text remains a kText operation with unchanged axes; row growth is a distinct kResize operation. Use existing prepare/commit explicit intent for all-or-nothing local apply and one History entry. Preserve existing independent operation publication/remote conflict semantics; no new remote transaction protocol. Undo/redo restores both text and height.
